purpose: Source-discovery research, NOT an active importer list. Keep requested promoters distinct from suggested record labels and venue/event feeds.
rules: Never activate an importer from this file: canonical enabled adapters are controlled separately in discovery/sources.json and require live source validation and owner-reviewed PR.
Release date, artist catalog entry, label affiliation, tour announcement or social post is a lead, NOT independently an event in Portland.
Every event must be confirmed with an original date/year, venue, bill and clock (or accurately date-only); preserve provenance, flyer rights and room identity.
Avoid conflating labels/promoters with named venue records; source evidence for a show must carry its actual host venue.
Technical accessibility does not determine editorial worth; failures and lack of an official feed are research gaps.
Clearly separate 'owner requested' for 777 Booking/Third Eye Booking from assistant-suggested labels and calendars.
